XXXIII. Resignation. From ‘Discipline’

George Herbert (1593–1633)

T
HROW
 away thy rod,
Throw away thy wrath;
O my God,
Take the gentle path!
For my heart’s desire
Unto thine is bent;
I aspire
To a full consent….
Throw away thy rod;
Though man frailties hath,
Thou art God;
Throw away thy wrath!
